reasoning: The magnitude of b is sqrt(8²+(-6)²)=10. Dividing by 10 gives (4/5,-3/5), which has magnitude 1 and points in the same direction as b. Choice c exactly matches Math Academy's worked solution.

answers.ma_evidence:
Finally, we divide $b$ by its length and get the following unit vector:

$$
\begin{aligned}u & =\frac{b}{|b|} \\  & =\frac{1}{10}\cdot b \\  & =\frac{1}{10}\cdot [\begin{aligned}8 \\ -6\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}\frac{4}{5} \\ -\frac{3}{5}\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$
